title: Yellow Spicy Ukrainian Mackerel Stew
description: A spicy and chewy weeknight Ukrainian dish featuring mackerel, tempered with chocolate for a unique flavor, served in a copper mug.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the paprika and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mackerel fillets and cook until browned, about 3 minutes.
Melt the dark chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Add the canned diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the melted chocolate and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the stew hot in copper mugs.
